system.name: Velosiraptor
system.one_liner: a system that synthesizes correct OS code for configuring memory-translation hardware from a high-level specification

components.name: Software
components.role: issues load/store operations that reach the mapping unit

components.name: map()
components.role: one of the unit's three main components; translates an input address/mode into an output address or exception

components.name: Interface
components.role: one of the unit's three main components; exposes reg/mem/mmio/instr operations and addmap()/setperms()/delmap() to the control plane

components.name: State
components.role: one of the unit's three main components; consists of registers and memory locations, queried by map() and updated via the Interface

content.key_idea: A memory-hardware mapping unit is modeled as a state machine with a data plane (map() translating addresses via State) and a control plane (Interface letting the OS update State), mirroring a network switch's data/control-plane split.
content.reading_order: Left-to-right along the data plane: Software issues load/store into Input, through map() to Output/exception; above, the control plane's Interface updates State that map() queries, separated by a dashed vertical divider.

summary: This figure gives the abstract behavioral model Velosiraptor uses for a memory-translation mapping unit ('unit'). The paper describes the unit as a state machine with three main components, shown as the dark boxes in the figure: map(), State, and Interface. On the data plane, Software issues load/store operations that arrive at the unit's Input as an (inaddr, mode) pair; map() translates this into an Output of (outaddr, mode) or raises an exception, consulting the unit's State (registers/memory) via a state query. On the control plane, separated by a dashed vertical line — echoing how a network switch separates data and control planes — an Interface exposes reg/mem/mmio/instr-style operations and the addmap()/setperms()/delmap() API that the OS uses to update State. This formal model is the abstraction that Velosiraptor's specification language describes and that its synthesis pipeline operates on.
summary_zh: 该图给出 Velosiraptor 对内存映射单元的抽象行为模型：类比网络交换机的数据面/控制面划分，数据面中 map() 函数查询内部状态将输入地址转换为输出地址或异常，控制面通过 Interface 更新该状态。
